facts: During any spin the Jackpot King Deluxe bonus can be triggered by five overlay symbols across reels 1-5.
The system is available on any stake on any game plugged into Jackpot King Deluxe.
Progressive jackpots are only won during the Wheel King stage of the bonus.
A won jackpot resets to its reserve amount.
Jackpot win chances increase with jackpot value; Royal and Regal are Must-Be-Won-By.
Jackpots are funded by player-stake contributions except operator-funded initial seeds.
officialHelpMechanism.hazardDecompositionImplication: Per-spin jackpot hazard is a compound mechanism involving entry into the Jackpot King Deluxe bonus and subsequent Wheel King/tier resolution. The public help does not disclose exact probabilities for these stages, so no exact hazard or EV threshold follows from these facts alone.
